test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 19 Sept 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
In the following question, the statement is followed by two conclusions. Which of the two conclusion(s) is/are true based on the given statement?

Statement: F ≤ I J ≥ H > L

Conclusions: I. G > F

II. L < J

options.text: Neither conclusion I nor II is true
Both conclusions I and II are true

solution:
Given Statement: F ≤ I J ≥ H > L

Now, Conclusions:

Option 1: G > F → False (The statement does not provide any information about G in relation to F)

Option 2: L L is given in the statement)

Option 3: I ≥ F → True (F ≤ I is given in the statement)

Option 4: J ≥ H → True (J ≥ H is given in the statement)

Option 5: L L and J ≥ H, it can be inferred that J > L. Also, F ≤ I and J is related to F and I, it can be inferred that I > L)

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 3".
